text:
sophia: Kicking off the change window now. Plan is to flip the router header-split flag + enable runtime kernel-batching=on for opt-in region. Need API pin (v2.14.1) and console release note entry. Keeping canary at 5% for first 10m.

jamal: ack. Which router header key are we toggling?

sophia: header: x-rd-routing=split-v2 -> fallback to split-v1 if mismatch. Router team asked for a soft toggle first.

kelsey: console docs updated with the UI note, added screenshots. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pull/4123 

matt: runtime change is a fast-path kernel selection: set KERNEL_BATCHING=enabled in runtime config. I ran a quick perf smoke in staging, 8% p99 improvement but CPU went up ~6%.

deploybot: deploybot created wave wave-838765-A for services: router, runtime, api, console. Canary=5% for 10m, then 50% for 15m, then 100%. Pin set for api-> v2.14.1 (pinned by jamal).

jamal: pinned api on prod to v2.14.1. If we see errors >0.5% 5xx in canary window, rollback criteria = immediate unpin + revert router flag.

ops-monitor: alert rule check: APM spans present. I've put a temp dashboard to track router x-rd-routing header ratio and api 5xx rate: https://observability/redwood/dash/822 

kelsey: release notes short text: "Router: gradual rollout of header-split routing (x-rd-routing). Runtime: experimental kernel batching enabled (opt-in). See console for config and metrics." added to release_notes.md in the console PR.

sophia: quick preflight checklist: 1) api pin ✅ 2) console note ✅ 3) runtime image pushed ✅ 4) router flag staged ✅ 5) monitoring dashboard ✅ 6) rollback runbook ready ✅

matt: deploying runtime to canary pool now. Commands:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env ds/runtime KERNEL_BATCHING=enabled --record
kubectl rollout status ds/runtime -w
```

deploybot: runtime rollout started (job id rb-838765-rt). Canary nodes: 12.

jamal: starting router header flip on 5% canary. curl test: 
```
curl -H "x-rd-routing: split-v2" https://api.redwood.internal/health
```
responds 200 from canary router.

ops-monitor: early metrics: api 5xx = 0.06% (baseline 0.03%). latency +12ms at p95. Kernel batching traces look normal. Keeping close eye.

sophia: keep canary window at 10m as planned. If 5xx crosses 0.5% or p95 increases >30% we rollback.

matt: after 7m, canary runtime cpu spiked on one shard. I drained that pod and restarted runtime on shard-7. No user-facing errors observed.

deploybot: canary progressed to 50% (wave wave-838765-A). Noted one nonfatal runtime restart.

jamal: API error budget still fine. Router header ratio: split-v2=52%, split-v1=48% among canary. Good traffic distribution.

ops-monitor: flagged a transient SLO spike at t+22m, p95 increased 25% but 5xx stayed below threshold. We'll continue to 100% but manual hold if trend continues.

kelsey: publishing the short release note now and emailing SRE/Support with summary.

sophia: proceeding to 100% after 5 more minutes of stable metrics. If anything odd, tag #eng-oncall and hit the rollback steps.

deploybot: roll to 100% completed for router/runtime/api/console. wave-838765-A closed.
